item.title: Re: The No Lying Space
item.content:encoded:
While this fits the paranoia of The Foundation, you need to decide if it's a room, a protocol, or an object. If it's just a security protocol, then it doesn't need to detain and should transform the person into a specific object, not another version of itself. If it's a room, then it can detain someone, but is unlikely to transform someone into a similar room; furnishing would work. An item works on its own.

It just seems like you had an idea, and then typed it in without really thinking about it. It's not a bad idea, but needs some serious editing.
